fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan's monetary policy committee kept the policy rate unchanged at 11%, neither raising nor cutting it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: Headline CPI inflation rose to 5.6% in September 2025 from about 3% in August 2025, according to the central bank's statement as read out in the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: Core inflation was reported unchanged at 7.3% in the central bank's latest statement.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The reporter argued inflation could exceed the central bank's 5-7% target range in the second half of FY26, because flood-driven food prices and low base effects push the number up, while the bank still sees inflation within range.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The central bank said flood damage to agriculture was smaller than it had expected, and it still expects farm output to grow about 4%, helped by better water availability and rabi crop yields.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The central bank's current account target range is a deficit of 0 to 1% of GDP; the reporter estimated 1% of GDP at about $4 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: PBS trade data record goods as they move across the border, while central bank balance-of-payments data record cash payments, so import payments can lag shipments and the two series can diverge.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The reporter expected imports to rise with economic recovery, which could turn the current account from the September 2025 surplus into a deficit in the following months.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: State Bank foreign exchange reserves were about $14.2 billion when the September 2025 policy decision was announced.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The central bank projects reserves of $15.5 billion by December 2025 and $17.8 billion by June 2026, up from an earlier June 2026 projection of $17.5 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: Pakistan's FY26 external payments are about $26 billion; about $4 billion, including a $2 billion rollover, was paid by September 2025, leaving about $22 billion due through June 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The central bank is confident the remaining external payments can be covered by inflows from the IMF, bilateral and multilateral lenders, or new commercial loans.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: Pakistan is a net importer of oil and other commodities, so a sharp rise in global oil or commodity prices feeds through to domestic inflation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The central bank's statement said the macroeconomic outlook has improved from its prior assessment, while flagging risk from volatile global commodity prices, mainly oil.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The central bank reported that a staff-level agreement with the IMF has been reached, which the reporter described as a positive development.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The market had expected an unchanged rate, so the reporter saw the central bank's positive tone as a possible confidence boost for investors rather than a non-event.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The reporter said the index looks fairly valued overall, but some individual banking and other cyclical stocks still look attractively valued.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The reporter said exports still need reform and that government efforts in this area have not yet shown results.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The SBP said its reserves stayed stable despite paying a $500 million Eurobond.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: Inflation rose from about 3% to 5% and then 5.5%, and was expected at 5.5% for October 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The trade deficit reached $3.5 billion when the trade data came out, which worried stock market participants.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: The current account deficit was under $600 million in the first quarter of FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)

fact_text: About $4 billion of external payments were made by September in FY26, including a $2 billion rollover and over $1.5 billion of repayments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-27)
